data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (weather 10-day lookup, BBC "{city} strike" search, drafted email with the same subject and body template) and has the right parameters. Its weaknesses are that it ends with "Send the email" when the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard, it uses a single recipient_email where the true parameter is {traveler} in {traveler}@example.com, and it leaves out the explicit clicks on To, Subject and Body, so an automation built from it could send a real email.
